title: Business Analysts - AVP
description:
Join us as a Business Analyst \- AVP at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful Business Analyst \- AVP you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Requirements elicitation and analysis
* User Story creation
* BRD / FRD preparation
* Process mapping
* Gap analysis
* Impact assessment
* Data analysis and reporting
* UAT coordination
* Client Onboarding
* KYC / AML
* Broking \& Trading
* Wealth Management
* Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
* Capital Markets
* Private Banking
* Client Lifecycle Management
* SQL and data analysis
* API and system integration concepts
* Understanding of application development lifecycle (SDLC)
* Agile and Scrum methodologies
* JIRA and Confluence
* Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Private Banking or Wealth Management platforms.
* Client onboarding systems and digital onboarding journeys.
* Broking and trading platforms.
* SEBI and RBI regulatory initiatives.
* Investment products and portfolio reporting.
* End\-to\-end project delivery in Agile environments.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)
* Experience working with offshore execution teams or across geographies

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:

 I’m now looking for a Co\-Founder who already has a strong coding/tech audience on social media and can lead the marketing and growth of the platform.

 This opportunity is specifically for someone who:
   

  

 \- Already has a large and active coding/technology audience on social media
   

 \- Has an established presence on platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, or other coding communities
   

 \- Can consistently promote LearnFullStack.in to their existing audience
   

 \- Has experience with content marketing, social media growth, and audience engagement
   

 \- Can build relationships with coding creators, influencers, colleges, and developer communities

 Marketing → Promotion → Audience Growth → Creator Partnerships → Community Building → User Acquisition

 This is NOT a salaried job.

 The idea is simple:
   

  

 “Watch less. Practice more.”
   

  

 LearnFullStack.in is designed around practical coding practice, interactive learning, quizzes, games, roadmaps, and certificates.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:

The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out\-of\-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).
   

  

 HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium\-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.
   

  

 MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT \& Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24\+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.
   

  

 Website: https://www.metro\-gsc.in

title: Executive - Domestic Payroll
description:

description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 As a Lead Security Research Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for vulnerability research, exploit analysis, exposure validation, and vulnerability signature development across the Qualys security platform. You will lead initiatives to identify, validate, and prioritise security risks based on real\-world exploitability, helping customers distinguish theoretical exposures from confirmed attack paths.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead vulnerability research initiatives across operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, cloud services, container platforms, and network devices.
* Research newly disclosed, N\-day, and actively exploited vulnerabilities.
* Lead the development of exploit\-based exposure validation techniques to confirm real\-world exploitability of vulnerabilities.
* Review technical designs, research methodologies, and code contributions to ensure quality and consistency.
* Partner with Engineering and Product teams to influence roadmap decisions and security content strategy.
* Design safe and controlled validation mechanisms that emulate attacker behavior without affecting production systems.
* Analyze vulnerability root causes, attack vectors, exploitability conditions, and potential business impact.
* Mentor and guide Security Research Engineers on vulnerability analysis, exploit analysis, and signature creation.
* Build validation logic capable of determining whether existing security controls such as WAFs, firewalls, EDRs, IPS, and compensating controls effectively prevent exploitation.
* Drive automation initiatives for vulnerability research, exploit validation, content generation, testing, and release processes.
* Establish best practices, coding standards, and quality guidelines for signature development.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, detection engineering, or security research.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SMTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and modern web protocols.
* Strong expertise in vulnerability analysis, exploit development, and attack techniques.
* Extensive knowledge of operating systems, databases, web technologies, cloud environments, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Strong coding background.
* Experience with packet analysis, network troubleshooting, and protocol reverse engineering.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, common attack techniques, and modern threat actor tactics.
* Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading projects and mentoring technical teams.


**Additional Plus Competencies:**
 Understanding of Lua (preferred), Bash, or Python.
   

  

 Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle, etc.).
   

  

 Proficient with regular expressions.
   

  

 Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
   

  

 Experienced in the use of vulnerability scanners, IDS, and security tools.
   

  

 OSCP, CISSP, or SANS GIAC certifications.

**Role \-** 




 Paid acquisition \- Google, Meta, Bing, and TikTok \- is a core growth lever.. We're bringing this in\-house: you will own paid performance end\-to\-end, replacing fragmented agency execution with a single accountable owner who tests, scales, and reports against real funnel outcomes \- not just platform metrics.
 



  





**What You'll Own \-** 



* Full\-funnel paid media strategy and hands\-on execution across Google, Meta, Bing, and TikTok.
* Budget allocation across platforms based on CAC/LTV and funnel data \- not platform\-reported ROAS alone.
* Tracking and attribution: GTM, GA4, CRM integration (GoHighLevel), conversion APIs, and call tracking, so every dollar traces to a funded loan, not just a lead.
* Creative testing roadmap \- ad copy, hooks, and landing pages \- in partnership with the content/design/Product team.
* Compliance\-safe campaign execution in a regulated vertical: Meta Special Ad Category, Google's financial\-services ad policy, TCPA considerations for lead\-gen calls/texts.
* Weekly/monthly reporting on CPL, CAC, and funnel conversion by channel vs. targets.Testing emerging channels and formats (TikTok, AI\-driven search/answer\-engine placements).
* Partnering with (and eventually reducing dependence on) external performance marketing agencies by bringing execution in\-house.



  





**What You Need \-** 



* 3\+ years running paid performance marketing for the US market, with real hands\-on ownership \- not just vendor management.
* Direct experience in mortgage, lending, fintech, insurance, or another regulated, high\-CAC lead\-gen vertical strongly preferred.
* Working expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Microsoft/Bing Ads; TikTok Ads Manager a strong plus.
* Fluency in attribution: GTM, GA4, UTM discipline, and CRM/CDP integration \- GoHighLevel experience a strong plus.
* Comfort with the numbers: CAC, LTV, ROAS math, building your own reporting in Excel/Sheets.
* Working knowledge of financial\-services advertising restrictions (Special Ad Category, TCPA, similar).



  





**Nice to have \-** 



* Experience scaling a channel from under $10M/month to $50\-100M/month in pipeline or revenue terms.
* Worked directly with sales/loan officer teams to improve lead quality, not just lead volume.
* Exposure to call\-tracking platforms (CallRail, Invoca) or live\-transfer lead\-gen models.
* Familiarity with SEO\-led D2C lending competitors (e.g., Griffin Funding) and the category more broadly.

description:
**\[Apply through the Excel sheet]**

 \~\~\~
   

  

 BDTC is a private limited company established in 2013 in Pune. It was founded by Avinash Anand Singh who is an international acclaimed peak performance coach. The company runs series of workshops and have participants from 9\+ countries. The company is standing at a verge of explosive growth and scale. Hence, we are looking for bright and skilled people to join the team.
   

  

 BDTC helps people move through a structured personal transformation journey — from an introductory program through to a deeper, immersive residential experience.
   

  

 A Program Counsellor is the human bridge in that journey: the person who speaks with someone who's shown interest, understands where they actually are in their life and what's holding them back, and helps them see clearly whether this program is the right next step for them — and if so, guides them to commit.
   

  

 This is a conversation\-first, relationship\-first role. A strong, structured sense of how to guide someone from interest to decision matters more than any specific industry background.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Personally own a pipeline of prospective participants from first conversation through to enrollment, staying accountable for outcomes at every stage.
   

  

 Have genuine, structured conversations that understand a person's situation, motivations, and hesitations before recommending anything.
   

  

 Address doubts and concerns (cost, timing, family buy\-in, uncertainty) honestly and with patience, helping people make a decision they feel good about, not one they're pushed into
   

  

 Maintain complete, accurate records of every conversation and interaction in the CRM your own visibility into your pipeline depends on this
   

 Consistently guide your pipeline toward monthly enrollment targets as an individual contributor
   

  

 Work closely with the wider counselling and marketing team, sharing insight on what's actually resonating (or not) with the people you're speaking to
   

 Progressively take on deeper, higher\-value conversations as you build a track record of trust and results
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

 3–4 years of experience in a role centered on guiding people to a decision — counselling, admissions, advisory, or a consultative client\-facing role
   

  

 A genuine, structured approach to conversations — real listening and understanding, not a fixed pitch
   

 Comfortable with a full journey involving multiple touchpoints (call, WhatsApp, video) over time, not a single interaction
   

  

 Good spoken English and Hindi
   

  

 Consistent, disciplined record\-keeping habits
   

 Nice to have, not required: prior experience guiding people toward higher\-value program upgrades or premium offerings
   

  

 Available for the full 6\-day, 9:30–6:30 WFO schedule

 Fixed base \+ performance\-linked incentive, tied to individual enrollment outcomes. Exact base discussed based on experience.

title: Life Coach
description:
**Company Description** 
 Atmantan Wellness Centre is a luxury wellness destination nestled in the crystal hills and overlooking the pristine Mulshi Lake, offering a tranquil environment for holistic healing. The centre focuses on integrated wellness for mind, body, and soul, combining modern science with traditional practices. Guests come for personalized wellness programs, including lifestyle transformation, stress management, and overall health optimization. Team members work in a serene, nature\-rich setting that supports both guest well\-being and professional growth for wellness practitioners.

 The Life Coach at Atmantan Wellness Centre is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune District. * Strong coaching and counseling skills, including goal\-setting, active listening, and motivational interviewing.

* Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to ethical guidelines and confidentiality.

title: Educational Consultant
description:
**About Application Ally** 




 Application Ally is a boutique education consulting firm that provides highly personalized guidance to students navigating the global admissions process. We combine thoughtful mentorship, strategic advice, and meticulous application support to help students present their strongest and most authentic candidacy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Education Consultant to support students applying primarily to Master’s programs around the world, with a particular focus on universities in the US and UK.
 



 This is a multifaceted role combining graduate admissions consulting, writing and editing, student mentorship, and project and program management. You will guide students through the entire application journey: from early\-stage planning and university selection to developing application materials and managing final submissions.
 



  





 You will also contribute to broader initiatives such as student workshops, school and institutional partnerships, and internal programs and projects. We welcome candidates with direct admissions experience, as well as accomplished writers, communicators, and project managers from other professional backgrounds who are excited about working in education."
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




*Graduate Admissions Consulting* 



* Guide students through the end\-to\-end graduate application process, primarily for Master’s programs.
* Help students identify suitable universities and programs based on their academic background, professional goals, interests, and preferences.
* Develop individualized application strategies, timelines, and action plans.
* Support students in shaping compelling personal narratives across their applications.
* Provide detailed guidance and editorial feedback on statements of purpose, personal statements, essays, résumés, and other application materials.
* Prepare students for admissions interviews where required.
* Track multiple application requirements and deadlines, ensuring that each application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
* Communicate regularly with students.



*Project and Program Management* 



* Plan and conduct workshops, information sessions, and other student\-facing programs.
* Support projects involving colleges, counsellors, and institutional partners.
* Coordinate timelines, stakeholders, communications, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with the Application Ally team to ensure a consistently high standard of service.
* Contribute ideas for improving student resources, programs, workflows, and internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and follow them through from planning to delivery.



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* An exceptional writer and editor with a strong command of English.
* A polished, thoughtful, and highly effective communicator.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple students, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* An attentive listener who can understand a student’s experiences and help them communicate their story authentically.
* Detail\-oriented, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership.
* Able to provide candid, constructive, and empathetic feedback.
* Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a close\-knit team.
* Interested in higher education and motivated by helping students achieve meaningful academic and professional goals.



  





**Experience** 




 We are flexible about years of experience and will evaluate candidates based on the strength and relevance of their overall profile.
 



 Previous experience in graduate admissions, education consulting, counselling, writing, editing, communications, project management, program management, or a related field is valuable but not essential. Strong writers and project managers seeking to transition into education consulting are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Why Join Application Ally?** 



* Do meaningful, high\-impact work with students at an important stage in their academic and professional journeys.
* Work in a boutique environment where every student receives personalized attention.
* Take on a varied role spanning consulting, mentorship, writing, workshops, partnerships, and program delivery.
* Join a collaborative team that values excellent work, thoughtful communication, and continuous learning.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn with your résumé or email it to anushkadesai@applicationally.net.

* Troubleshoot production issues, perform log analysis, support root cause analysis, and resolve advanced support escalations
* Develop and support application programming interface\-based automation, reporting, reconciliation, and custom integrations for privileged access management processes

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations

* Continuous Compliance

* Experience with Delinea Secret Server administration and support

title: Copilot Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role partners across Global Services, Partner Delivery, Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Support to create a seamless path from solution design through adoption and value realization.
   

  

 Success means more than a technical go\-live. Customers should realize tangible improvements in workforce visibility, scheduling and labor efficiency, time and payroll accuracy, compliance, manager productivity, and employee experience.

 Strategy and transformation — Define and execute the India WFM implementation strategy in alignment with UKG priorities. Modernize delivery through standardized methods, scalable operating models, and a bias for measurable improvement.

 People leadership and capability building — Lead, coach, and scale a high\-performing India organization. Build capabilities in architecture, governance, advisory, analytics, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement while creating a culture of accountability and innovation.
   

  

 Global and partner collaboration — Build trusted relationships with global leaders and implementation partners. Establish governance, enablement, quality controls, escalation paths, and shared accountability for consistent customer outcomes.

 Customer outcomes, adoption, value realization, and satisfaction

 Productivity, utilization, capacity planning, forecast accuracy, and financial performance
   

  

 AI and automation adoption, administrative effort reduced, and repeatable work industrialized
   

  

 Employee engagement, capability growth, leadership depth, and partner performance
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
   

  

 7\+ years of senior leadership experience in SaaS delivery, implementation services, professional services, or enterprise services.
   

  

 Demonstrated success leading transformational change and scaling implementation or professional services teams in India.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Human Capital Management and Workforce Management; UKG WFM or comparable SaaS experience highly preferred.
   

  

 Experience leading complex, multi\-region implementations across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise segments, with strong HCM/WFM domain knowledge.
   

  

 Proven ability to define and deliver customer value outcomes beyond implementation completion or technical go\-live.
   

  

 Experience using AI, automation, analytics, and digital tools to improve efficiency, decision quality, and customer experience.
   

  

 Strong financial and operational acumen, including budgets, forecasts, utilization, capacity planning, and business performance; able to operate across cultures and time zones.
   

  

 Exceptional communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship\-building skills, with an innovative, entrepreneurial mindset and bias toward action.
   

  

 Willingness and ability to travel as required and work flexibly across time zones.
   

  

 The UKG difference
   

  

 You will help build a modern delivery organization that is powered by AI, scaled through global delivery centers, extended by partners, and elevated by advisory services. title: Senior Patch Research Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Qualys is looking for a detail\-oriented Windows Patch Management Catalog Researcher to join the Patch Management product team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive, accurate patch catalog covering a wide range of third\-party Windows software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Patch Catalog Research \& Authoring


 Research, author, and maintain patch metadata for third\-party Windows applications across a broad software catalog.
   

  

 Identify new software releases, security updates, and version changes from vendor sources, changelogs, and security advisories (CVE/NVD).
   

  

 Map vendor releases to structured metadata schemas, including version strings, download URLs, detection logic, and installation parameters.
   

  

 Track software End\-of\-Life (EOL) dates and update catalog entries accordingly.
   

  

* Windows Patching \& Installation Knowledge


 Document and validate silent installation parameters for diverse installer types (MSI, NSIS EXE, InnoSetup, WiX, etc.).
   

  

 Research and verify correct msiexec.exe flags, NSIS /S switches, and equivalent silent/unattended arguments per software.
   

  

 Determine accurate reboot behavior (Yes / No / Maybe) per installer type and document exit codes (success, reboot\-required).
   

  

 Manually test patch installation in sandbox environments and verify detection logic post\-install.
   

  

* Detection Logic \& Registry Research


 Research and validate Windows registry keys used to detect installed software versions (Uninstall hive, vendor\-specific keys, DisplayVersion, etc.).
   

  

 Identify and document file\-based detection paths (FileVersion, ProductVersion attributes on key executables).
   

  

 Understand the difference between 32\-bit and 64\-bit registry views (WOW6432Node) and apply correct detection architecture per installer variant.
   

  

 Validate detection logic against fresh installs and upgrades across supported Windows versions.
   

  

* Backend Patch Tool Understanding


 Understand how enterprise patch management platforms (e.g., Qualys Patch Management, SCCM, Ivanti, Adaptiva) discover, deploy, and verify patches.
   

  

 Familiarity with how catalogs are consumed by patch engines — detection\-before\-install logic, supersedence evaluation, and deployment policy enforcement.
   

  

* Required Skills \& Qualifications


 4\-5 years of experience in Windows systems administration, patch management, or software packaging.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Windows OS internals — registry structure, file system, user vs. system installation scopes, environment variables, and PATH management.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Windows patching tools (WSUS, SCCM/ConfigMgr, Ivanti, Qualys, Chocolatey, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with manual patch installation — running MSI/EXE installers, using msiexec.exe with switches, repackaging software.
   

  

 Solid understanding of installer technologies: MSI/WiX, NSIS, InnoSetup, Squirrel, and their silent install mechanisms.
   

  

 Familiarity with the Windows registry and the ability to trace installation artifacts to their registry keys.
   

  

* Nice to Have


 Experience building or maintaining a software patch catalog (Adaptiva, Chocolatey, ManageEngine, or similar).
   

  

 Experience with Windows Installer (MSI) internals — product codes, upgrade codes, component tables.
   

  

 Knowledge of ARM64 Windows platform nuances and multi\-architecture software distribution.
   

  

 Good understanding of Windows Update infrastructure (WUA, WSUS, CBS/SFC).
   

  

 Scripting experience in Python or PowerShell.

title: Content Planning & Execution
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **AVP – Brand (Content Focused)** 
 to own the planning, production and execution of content across key consumer touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, delivery\-oriented role for someone who knows how to take a content plan from brief to final output, coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensure a consistent volume of high\-quality content is shipped on time.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the growth team and leadership to translate the brand direction into content across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other consumer\-facing channels. A significant part of the role will also involve managing shoots, creators, freelancers and external production partners.
   

  

 This is
 **not a traditional Creative Director role** 
 . While strong creative judgement is important, success in this position will be defined primarily by the ability to run a disciplined content engine and deliver consistently.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Content Planning \& Execution
   

  

* Own and manage the monthly content calendar across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other relevant brand channels.
* Translate the content plan into clear briefs, timelines and deliverables for internal and external teams.
* Coordinate assets from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Ensure content is delivered consistently and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain visibility on work in progress, dependencies and upcoming content requirements.


 Content Production \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Manage a network of freelance editors, photographers, designers, production partners and shoot crews.
* Write clear creative and production briefs and ensure external partners understand the expected output.
* Review creative work and provide actionable feedback on quality, brand fit and execution.
* Manage production costs and work towards maintaining an efficient cost per asset without compromising output quality.
* Build a reliable production workflow capable of supporting a consistent volume of content.


 Shoots \& On\-Ground Production
   

  

* Own product, farm and factory\-related shoots end\-to\-end, including planning, coordination and execution.
* Work with photographers, videographers, production teams and relevant internal stakeholders to ensure shoots are completed as planned.
* Be comfortable being present on location and managing the practical requirements of content production.
* Ensure shoot outputs are translated efficiently into usable content across multiple formats and channels.


 Creator \& Influencer Operations
   

  

* Run the creator and influencer programme as a structured operating process.
* Source and evaluate relevant creators and influencers.
* Manage negotiations, briefs, timelines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
* Track output quality and ensure creator content is aligned with the broader brand direction.


 Growth Creative Support
   

  

* Work closely with the growth team to ensure a consistent weekly pipeline of creative assets.
* Understand creative performance data and use it to inform what types of content and formats should be produced next.
* Help increase the volume of relevant creative while maintaining brand and execution standards.


 Brand Consistency
   

  

* Maintain consistency in the brand's voice, visual identity and core consumer narrative across all content.
* Ensure the brand's farm\-to\-home trust story is represented consistently across touchpoints.
* Translate the leadership team's positioning and brand direction into day\-to\-day content execution.
* Review outgoing content for quality, consistency and adherence to the agreed brand direction.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* 4\-7 years of experience in a brand, creative or D2C growth agency environment.
* Experience in account management, client servicing, brand solutions or a similar role involving ownership of content delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing content calendars across multiple brands, campaigns or workstreams.
* Strong track record of coordinating production teams, freelancers and external creative partners against deadlines.
* Experience managing content from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Comfortable working directly with photographers, editors, designers, creators and shoot teams.
* Strong creative judgement with the ability to assess whether content meets the expected quality and brand standard.
* Highly execution\-oriented, organised and comfortable managing several content deliverables simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with performance data and using creative learnings to influence subsequent content production.
* Willing to take a hands\-on role in shoots and on\-ground content production.
* Pune\-based or willing to relocate to Pune.


**Preferred Experience**
* Exposure to food, dairy, wellness, FMCG or adjacent consumer categories.
* Experience working with D2C or digitally led consumer brands.
* Hands\-on ability to produce or edit content independently would be a strong advantage.
* Experience managing creator or influencer programmes as an ongoing operating process.


 What Success in This Role Looks Like
   

  

 Success in this role will come from building a dependable content operation: calendars are planned ahead, briefs are clear, production partners deliver on time, shoots run smoothly, creators are managed systematically, the growth team receives the creative volume it needs, and everything that reaches the consumer remains consistent with the brand's voice and positioning.

The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, following up on warm leads, handling basic objections, and ensuring a steady pipeline of qualified meetings. The executive will collaborate closely with sales and marketing teams to align messaging, refine scripts, and improve conversion rates. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division.
 



**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English and the ability to engage professionally with business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in lead generation and appointment setting, with familiarity in using CRM or lead management tools to track activities and outcomes.
* Ability to conduct brief prospect research, understand basic B2B sales and marketing concepts, and tailor outreach messages accordingly.
* Comfort with outbound calling, email outreach, and social platforms (such as LinkedIn) for prospecting and follow\-up.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize tasks, and meet daily/weekly targets.
* Collaborative mindset to work with sales and marketing teams, share feedback from prospects, and contribute to refining scripts and campaigns.
* Relevant experience in inside sales, telecalling, business development, or similar appointment\-setting roles in a B2B environment is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: graduate degree or equivalent; familiarity with IT, SaaS, or marketing services domains is a plus.

title: Workplace Specialist
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive
 **Workplace Specialist** 
 to join our Workplace team. The Workplace Specialist will lead the planning, execution, and monitoring of technical operations related to workplace infrastructure, ensuring optimal functionality, compliance, and safety. This includes oversight of HVAC, electrical systems, fire safety, preventive maintenance, and Emergency Response Team (ERT) management. The role is a full time in office and would be reporting directly to the Director, Workplace Asia, Middle East \& Africa
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Emergency Facility Repairs \& Breakdown Handling
* Lead coordination during critical infrastructure breakdowns and service disruptions.
* Mobilize internal and external resources to resolve facility emergencies promptly.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain a facility incident log for review, audits, and trend analysis.
* Preventive Maintenance (PPM) Management
* Plan, execute, and track preventive maintenance schedules for all workplace systems.
* Ensure all PPM records are updated, validated, and compliant with audit standards.
* Monitor vendor SLAs and maintenance quality metrics to ensure service excellence.
* Promote data\-driven maintenance practices to optimize asset performance and longevity.
* Workplace Infrastructure Assessments
* Conduct routine assessments of all workplace infrastructure including HVAC systems, electrical panels, fire safety equipment, and structural facilities.
* Evaluate the physical condition and performance of workplace assets to detect wear\-and\-tear, potential failures, or inefficiencies.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal stakeholders to ensure timely inspections, servicing, and reporting.
* Oversee the maintenance and operational condition of workplace furniture, including workstations, chairs, and ergonomic equipment, to prevent breakdowns or safety hazards.
* Coordinate with external vendors for repairs, replacements, or reconfiguration of furniture systems and seating to avoid user discomfort or injury.
* Ensure asset tagging, tracking, and inventory of movable infrastructure items is kept up to date.
* Document all assessments with detailed reports, action plans, and timelines for corrective or preventive measures.
* Provide recommendations to improve workplace functionality and employee safety based on audit findings.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Workplace Safety
* Ensure full compliance with local/national safety regulations (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, ASHRAE).
* Maintain and review technical and safety documentation for all workplace systems.
* Liaise with auditors and safety inspectors during regulatory inspections and audits.
* Lead efforts to close non\-compliance gaps with documented proof of resolution.
* HVAC, Electrical \& Fire Maintenance Oversight


**HVAC Systems**
* Oversee operations and scheduled maintenance of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems.
* Ensure efficient airflow, appropriate climate control, and compliance with air quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters like temperature, humidity, refrigerant pressure, and energy usage.


**Electrical Systems**
* Manage power distribution systems, UPS units, switchgear, and emergency generators.
* Ensure electrical load balancing, safe wiring practices, and redundancy in critical systems.
* Maintain electrical schematics and conduct periodic electrical safety checks.


**Fire Safety Systems**
* Administer testing, maintenance, and documentation of fire detection and suppression systems.
* Ensure availability of functional fire extinguishers, alarms, smoke detectors, and sprinklers.
* Collaborate with certified vendors for statutory fire equipment inspections and certifications.
* Emergency Response Team (ERT) Management
* Lead the formation, training, and readiness of the Emergency Response Team.
* Plan and conduct scheduled fire evacuation drills, mock emergency scenarios, and safety briefings.
* Develop ERT protocols aligned with company policies and local emergency guidelines.
* Ensure availability and maintenance of emergency equipment (first\-aid kits, stretchers, PA systems, etc.).
* Keep detailed records of all ERT activities, drills, incident responses, and post\-drill assessments.
* Drive compliance with workplace emergency response regulations and best practices.


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of technical project management experience in corporate facilities or infrastructure.
* Proven expertise in HVAC, electrical, fire safety, and emergency systems.
* Solid understanding of workplace safety regulations and technical compliance frameworks.
* Strong communication, vendor management, and documentation capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI tools and technologies to drive smarter decision\-making, automate routine tasks, and enhance workplace operations efficiency.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Client Experience Executive
description:
Markup Club is a SEBI\-registered Research Analyst firm offering Model Portfolios and Bespoke trading strategies to subscribers who execute recommendations through their own connected broking accounts. This role exists to make sure every subscriber, especially a first\-time one, actually has a smooth experience getting their portfolio live, executing their first rebalance, and getting unstuck when something on the platform confuses them.
   

  

 This role owns proactive onboarding for every new subscriber, following up shortly after activation to guide them through accepting their first portfolio or pushing their first rebalance, rather than waiting for them to get stuck and write in. The goal is a smooth first experience, since this is often where a new subscriber's confidence in the platform is won or lost.
   

  

 This role also owns first\-line resolution of subscriber support queries received through email and the Zoho Desk ticketing system, covering payment and activation questions, rebalance and execution confusion, dashboard queries, and subscription or billing matters. Every reply should be accurate, warm, and written in a professional, clear tone, within the committed first\-response timeline.
   

  

 Ticket volume is modest on most days but spikes meaningfully around scheduled rebalances, particularly for Bespoke strategies, so this role needs to handle a quiet day and a high\-volume day equally well without either one suffering. Where a query turns out to be a genuine platform issue rather than a misunderstanding, this role coordinates with the technical team to get a root cause and follows up until it is resolved.
   

  

 A meaningful part of this role is proactive, not reactive. When a pattern of similar queries emerges across subscribers, the expectation is to recognise it, flag it, and either draft or update a knowledge base article covering it.
   

  

 This role also involves occasional subscriber calls where a written reply will not resolve the concern, particularly for a confused first\-time subscriber, a rebalance gone wrong, or an escalation, and is expected to de\-escalate calmly and represent Markup Club's tone and values on those calls.
   

  

**Requirements**
 As a mandatory requirement under SEBI regulations for Research Analyst firms, the selected candidate will be required to clear the NISM\-Series\-XXV\-A: Persons Associated with Research Services (Sales and Other Non\-Core Services) Certification Examination before joining. Candidates should also be comfortable working on\-site in Pune and be able to demonstrate strong written communication and problem\-solving skills through a practical screening assignment as part of the hiring process. Familiarity with a ticketing system such as Zoho Desk, or the willingness to learn it quickly, is expected.
   

  

 Prior trading or broking industry background is a good to have, not a requirement. What matters most is excellent written English, patience with non\-technical users, comfort on the phone, and the willingness to genuinely learn how the platform, brokers, and rebalancing mechanics work well enough to explain them simply. A basic understanding of SEBI regulations around Research Analysts, particularly around what language can and cannot be used regarding automated execution and investment advice, will be built on the job.
   

  

**Benefits**
 CTC in the range of ₹3,00,000 to ₹4,80,000 per annum, based on communication skills and demonstrated aptitude, with room to grow as the role's scope and the subscriber base expand.
   

  

 Health insurance reimbursement of up to ₹5,000 per annum, for a minimum coverage of ₹5 lakhs.
   

  

 A company\-wide performance bonus tied to overall business profitability. Each year, 7\.5 percent of the profit pool is set aside as an employee fund and distributed among all team members in April, based on the number of days worked during that financial year.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder in a growing SEBI\-registered research and advisory business, with genuine ownership over the subscriber experience and the knowledge base from day one, rather than a narrowly scripted support role.

title: Duty Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 StayBird Hospitality operates a growing portfolio of business hotels, serviced apartments, and extended\-stay properties across Pune’s key business corridors, including Kharadi, Magarpatta, and Viman Nagar, all located minutes from Pune International Airport. Since 2009, the company has expanded from a single property to over six hotels and apartment\-style accommodations, supported by in\-house dining brands such as Cafe Rova, Cafe Bliss, and Cafe Aura, as well as dedicated event venues including Tulip, Orchid, and Lotus Banquets. StayBird focuses on building hospitality experiences around the guest, prioritizing comfort and convenience for corporate travelers and business teams. With 500\+ combined 5\-star reviews across platforms, the company offers reliable stays for both short and extended business trips. Team members join a customer\-centric environment designed to meet the needs of modern business travel.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Duty Manager role at StayBird Hospitality is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Pune. The Duty Manager oversees daily hotel operations, ensuring smooth functioning of front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, and guest services during assigned shifts. Responsibilities include managing guest check\-ins and check\-outs, handling escalated service issues, coordinating with different departments to meet service standards, and monitoring property appearance and safety. The role also involves supervising shift staff, managing duty rosters, ensuring adherence to policies and procedures, and supporting training for new team members. The Duty Manager prepares basic reports, tracks occupancy and revenue\-related data, and actively contributes to guest satisfaction and brand reputation.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong guest service and customer relationship skills, with the ability to handle escalations and resolve issues promptly.
* Experience in front office operations, reservations, and coordination with housekeeping and food and beverage teams.
* Supervisory capabilities, including shift management, team coordination, and basic people management skills.
* Operational awareness in hotel safety, security, and compliance with standard operating procedures.
* Good communication skills in English and local languages, with clear, professional interpersonal abilities.
* Basic proficiency in hotel property management systems, MS Office, and report preparation.
* Relevant experience in hospitality operations, preferably in business hotels or serviced apartments.
* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and holidays, as per operational requirements.
* Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving mindset, and commitment to guest\-centric service.

title: SAP Data Migration and Data Integration Expert
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You work within Siemens Energy’s SAP S/4HANA environment, focusing on master data migration and integration. Your day combines hands\-on MDG migration execution with deep data analysis, mapping design, and business validation. You collaborate with data governance, integration, and business teams to ensure migrated master data is technically correct, deduplicated, and usable in end\-to\-end business processes.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute SAP MDG master data migrations (BP, Customer, Vendor, Material) within the S/4HANA environment.
* Define and implement data migration strategies, mapping rules, and transformation logic for legacy to S/4 conversion
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and deduplication activities aligned with business rules
* Design and execute ETL processes (Extraction, Transformation, Load) using SAP BODS, Snowflake, or similar tools.
* Build and run staging, reconciliation, and validation frameworks using Snowflake and advanced SQL.
* Manage large\-scale MDG mass processing / CMP loads, including error handling and reprocessing.
* Define and validate business mapping rules (e.g., bank, tax, sales areas, partner functions, roles) across segments
* Perform data reconciliation and migration testing (unit, SIT, mock loads, cutover) to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Analyze and resolve MDG migration errors, data inconsistencies, and replication issues across integrated systems.
* Collaborate with business and governance stakeholders to ensure data usability, compliance, and process fit.
* Support cutover planning, migration sequencing, and go\-live readiness activities.
* Work with data governance, business, and integration teams to ensure end\-to\-end usability of data.


**What You Bring**
* 5–8 years of experience in SAP MDG functional processes and data model management.
* Strong understanding of SAP MDG data models, including Business Partner (BP), Material, Customer, Vendor, and the staging and active areas.
* Expertise across key master data domains, including:
+ Address and communication data
+ Bank and payment data
+ Tax structures
+ Business Partner roles and relationships
+ Identification objects

* Strong understanding of cross\-object dependencies and integration impacts, including BP ↔ Customer ↔ Vendor ↔ FI/SD/MM.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake and SQL for staging, reconciliation, and validation.
* Strong expertise with ETL tools such as SAP BODS and migration automation.
* Experience managing large\-volume datasets and optimizing performance for mass data loads.
* Ability to design and execute data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and error logs.
* Experience extracting and staging data from legacy systems such as SAP ECC and non\-SAP platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve migration failures related to data inconsistencies, mapping issues, configuration gaps, and replication failures.
* Experience with log analysis including SAP BODS logs, MDG staging logs, and IDoc/DRF errors.
* Hands\-on experience with MDG mass processing, CMP loads, migration testing cycles, mock loads, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and business sign\-off processes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, data stewards, and integration teams.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with MDG key mapping and value mapping frameworks and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of BRF\+ for validations, derivations, and duplicate check tuning.
* Familiarity with MDG staging, extensibility, and governance workflows.
* Exposure to SAP migration tools and accelerators.
* Experience with cutover planning, migration sequencing, and hypercare support.


**About The Team**
 Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Manager, Benefits & Leave Administration Transformation & Process Optimization (GBSC People & Capability)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Benefits \& Leave Administration Transformation \& Process Optimization (GBSC People \& Capability)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Who is GBSC?
   

  

 The Global Business Solutions Center (GBSC) is a powerhouse of innovation and strategic partnership inside of Mastercard that combines operational excellence with a vision for what’s next. More than a service provider; it is a collaborative force that delivers impactful outcomes. Anchored in strong, reliable operations, the GBSC brings to life bold ideas that empower teams across Finance, Legal, People \& Capability, Sales, Marketing, and Product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Manager, Benefits \& Leave Administration Process Design \& Optimization Lead is responsible for designing, optimizing, and continuously improving global benefits and leave administration processes to ensure they are standardized, compliant, employee centric, and digitally enabled across countries.
   

  

 This role applies leading practice process architecture, documentation, governance enablement frameworks, and optimization initiatives across the end to end benefits lifecycle—including benefit eligibility, enrollment, life event changes, ongoing administration, vendor interactions, employee communications, reporting, and post event activities—while partnering closely with regional Benefits teams, Technology, Risk, and external providers.
   

  

 The role enables consistent benefits outcomes and improved employee experiences by defining scalable process standards, controls, and metrics that support Mastercard’s broader modernization and automation agenda, while execution accountability remains with regional and in country Benefits teams.
   

  

 Success in this role requires working in close alignment with Benefits leadership to translate strategic direction into executable, scalable, and continuously improving process outcomes.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with Benefits and Leave Administration leadership to support global benefits process design and optimization efforts, contributing insights, analysis, and structured frameworks that inform the evolution of future state process standards across the benefits lifecycle.
* Enable and support the development, alignment, and use of benefits process flows and documentation by partnering with Benefits, Leave Administration, and related teams, to ensure artifacts are clear, practical, and reflective of agreed upon operating models; support consistent understanding and execution across regions while accounting for local regulatory, plan design, and business requirements.
* Manage the Benefits and Leave Administration Transformation portfolio, including intake, prioritization, transformation roadmap, and work sequencing.
* Provide structured analysis and recommendations to Benefits leadership on global versus localized benefits approaches, helping articulate global standards and permissible country level variation; assess process variation and present fact based insights to support leadership decision making.
* Act as a process design lead and trusted advisor for benefits related changes, system enhancements, vendor transitions, country implementations, and operating model evolution—translating business needs into tangible, prioritized process requirements aligned to Benefits strategy.
* Partner with Product \& Engineering to simplify, automate, and optimize benefits processes and data flows, ensuring designs align to Workday Benefits capabilities and third party provider integrations.
* Support enhancement testing by providing relevant use cases and executing user testing to validate optimized process designs are viable, system enabled, and fit for purpose.
* Leverage benefits and leave administration process performance metrics to identify trends, prioritize optimization opportunities, and track continuous improvement over time.
* Support cross functional and vendor process alignment by partnering with P\&C, Legal, Tax, Risk \& Compliance, and benefits providers to promote service quality, regulatory adherence, data privacy, security, and operational efficiency.
* Assess benefits process impacts of policy changes, acquisitions, technology advancements, workforce changes, and regulatory developments; support impact analysis, documentation updates, and stakeholder communications.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Qualifications \& Leadership Profile**
* 7\+ years of experience in global benefits and leave administration, benefits and/or leave administration process design, or shared services environments, with strong knowledge of multi country benefits programs, regulatory requirements, and operational controls.
* Demonstrated experience designing, standardizing, and enabling end to end processes within complex, matrixed, global organizations—ideally within a Global Business Services, consulting, or transformation led model.
* Strong working knowledge of HR and benefits technology/vendor ecosystems (for example, Workday Benefits and third party administrators), including process enablement for automation and workflow tools.
* Proven understanding of audit requirements, regulatory reviews, and risk management expectations, with the ability to translate control needs into practical, scalable process design.
* Advanced analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to balance precision, scalability, and employee experience in regulated environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across regions, functions, and leadership levels.
* Enterprise first mindset with clear accountability for process integrity, quality, and continuous improvement, paired with a calm, structured, and pragmatic decision making approach.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
