description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
 As a Representative, Planner \& Order Fulfillment, you'll play a critical role in ensuring customers receive the right products at the right time while supporting an efficient, resilient, and globally connected supply chain. Working closely with manufacturing plants, distribution centers, suppliers, sales teams, and customer service partners, you'll balance customer demand, inventory optimization, and material availability to drive operational excellence.
   

  

 In this role, you'll help transform supply chain plans into execution by managing material flow, supporting order fulfillment activities, and proactively mitigating risks that could impact customer deliveries. Your expertise in planning, supplier coordination, and ERP systems will directly contribute to improved service levels, inventory performance, and business outcomes across Danfoss' global operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Develop and execute material and fulfillment plans based on customer demand, forecasts, production schedules, and order requirements to ensure material availability and on\-time delivery.
* Coordinate supply and inventory across global manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and suppliers while resolving shortages, capacity constraints, and supply disruptions.
* Conduct daily order book reviews, manage order changes, create deliveries, and collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, and Logistics teams to align customer expectations with supply capabilities.
* Utilize SAP planning tools to execute MRP activities, maintain planning parameters, and ensure the accuracy of inventory, lead time, supplier, and master data.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, supply chain efficiency, process standardization, and operational performance.


 Beyond day\-to\-day planning activities, you'll provide insights during S\&OP discussions, support sourcing and supply chain improvement projects, and develop recovery plans for critical supply risks to ensure uninterrupted customer service.
   

  

**Essential Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6\-8 years of experience in material planning, supply planning, inventory management, or order fulfillment within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes, including MRP, inventory management, demand planning, and supplier coordination.
* Hands\-on experience using SAP (MM/PP) or comparable ERP planning systems, combined with advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across global and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 APICS CPIM or CSCP certification, experience supporting global manufacturing networks, and familiarity with Power BI or other reporting and analytics tools will be considered an advantage. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and inventory optimization methodologies is also highly desir
   

  

**What You'll Get From Us**
* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. Your well\-being matters to us.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
* You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

title: Advanced Services Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout**
 Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
   

  

 For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
 At Forescout, we seek customer driven individuals who thrive on collaboration, embrace innovation, and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working as one team, we anticipate emerging threats and create forward\-thinking solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity. Join us and make a meaningful impact through your unique talents and perspective.
   

  

 The Advanced Services Engineer (ASE) position at Forescout Technologies offers the opportunity to assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem\-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real\-world customer environments. The ASE will troubleshoot the Forescout solutions, provide upgrade and deployment best practices to the base Forescout Solution, as well as integrate the Forescout product with other customer third\-party software, such as remote access and SIEM technologies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop a deep understanding of Forescout products and in\-depth knowledge of environments in which they are deployed.
* Provide complex product support, in a collaborative team environment, to customers, other Forescout employees, and partners.
* Participate in knowledge transfer with teammates, attend formal team training sessions, brown bags, and formal mentoring.
* Routinely monitor and develop knowledge assets to enable customer self\-sufficiency.
* Monitor and manage Support Services cases.
* Achieve a high level of expertise in all areas of the product.
* Capable of completing assigned duties, handling cases, and escalations within guidelines with minimal direction from Support Services Leadership.
* Routinely act independently while researching and developing solutions to customer issues.
* Liaison to Engineering on product issues, including design, features, and defects.
* Acts as a technical point of contact and is repeatedly sought by others to provide specialty knowledge to assist them in their problem\-solving.
* Administer and mature a customer enterprise deployment of the Forescout solution.
* Interface with Forescout Support and/or R\&D to resolve issues that may impede success.
* Analyse and optimize polices in accordance with customers’ business requirements.
* Manage equipment installation and configuration at all locations, to include lab environments.
* Assist customers with planning and executing Forescout software and hardware upgrades.
* Create customer reports to achieve project alignment and unity of effort.


**What You Will Bring To Forescout**
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Expertise in debugging and root\-cause analysis in complex systems and large environments
* Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and strong knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networks to include ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches.
* Experience with the configuration of Forescout products.
* Hands\-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP\+, Security\+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware \-vSphere, Microsoft Hyper\-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows\-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large\-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti\-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong customer orientation, good organizational skills, self\-driven with the ability to multi\-task on various projects, and aptitude to learn new technologies.
* Knowledge/experience utilizing Salesforce.com or similar CRM tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working in demanding and challenging environments.
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* ForeScout Certified Administrator (FSCA) and/or ForeScout Certified Engineer (FSCE) within the first year of employment.
* A self\-motivated individual with a ‘can do’ attitude.


**What Forescout Offers You**
 Managing cyber risk, together – We are led by a visionary leadership team who encourages professional growth and development. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture providing for a collaborative and innovative environment where our team can make an impact on worldwide security while working on technology which is at the forefront of the industry. We are also proud of our competitive compensation and benefits offered. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.
* Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.


**Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us.
   

  

 If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply!**
**Pre\-Employment Screening and Verification**
 At Forescout, we are “Cyber Obsessed”. As a global cybersecurity company, we are committed to maintaining a secure environment for our customers, employees, and business operations. To support these efforts, candidates may be asked to complete job\-related pre\-employment screening and verification processes, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Depending on the role and location, these measures may include identity verification, employment verification, background screening, work authorization verification, and other lawful security\-related checks. Forescout conducts these processes in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including privacy and data protection requirements, and obtains any required notices, authorizations, or consents before conducting such screenings.
   

  

**Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment**
 As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence ("AI") or automated decision\-support tools to review applications, assess job\-related qualifications, match candidates to role requirements, and coordinate interviews. These tools support, but do not replace, the judgment of qualified recruiters and hiring managers, who remain involved throughout the process. We use AI responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards.
   

  

**Note to Employment Agencies**
 We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Forescout does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.  Submissions made without a signed Employment Placement Agreement and an authorized search engagement for the specific position through our Talent Acquisition team will be considered unsolicited, and no placement fee will be paid.
   

  

 Forescout Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We value and embrace diversity, equality, inclusion, and collaboration at the core of our “One Team” philosophy. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Growth Associate (EA to CEO)
description:
**Role Overview**
 This is not a typical Executive Assistant role where you manage calendars and book meeting rooms. As a Growth Associate, your primary focus will be on business development, partnerships, outreach, and operational coordination. You will work directly with the CEO to help open new revenue streams and ensure that day to day operations run smoothly across the organisation.
   

  

 Think of this role as a mix of business development, operations management, and team coordination, all rolled into one. You will be handling partner outreach, corporate client engagement, campaign execution, event logistics, media coordination, and team task management. The CEO will rely on you to independently drive these areas forward so that the company's growth never slows down because of a lack of bandwidth.
   

  

 If you are someone who enjoys taking ownership, talking to new people, managing multiple workstreams, and seeing your work directly impact the business, this is the role for you.
   

  

**Who Should Apply?**
 This role is a great fit for you if you enjoy talking to new people and building professional relationships. You should be comfortable writing emails, making calls, and following up persistently until things get done. If you can manage multiple tasks at the same time without dropping any, this role will suit you well.
   

  

 It is ideal for someone who likes working in a fast paced, small team environment where your work directly impacts the business. You should be comfortable using cloud tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, ClaudeAI, Genspark, and other to get things done faster. If you want a role where no two days look the same and you get to be involved in everything from partnerships to team management, this is the one.
   

  

**Key Responsibility Areas**
* Partnership and Collaboration Outreach A significant part of your role will involve identifying and reaching out to potential partners across the financial ecosystem. This includes financial advisors, influencers, platforms, and media houses. You will be responsible for drafting outreach emails, following up systematically, maintaining a partnership pipeline, and scheduling calls between the CEO and interested parties. The goal is to take a partnership from the first point of contact all the way to closure.
* Corporate Client Development You will research and identify companies that could benefit from our financial wellness offerings. This involves finding the right decision makers within organisations, preparing pitch materials, booking presentations for the CEO, and handling all follow up after meetings. You will manage the entire cycle from initial outreach to final onboarding.
* Campaign Management You will own and manage outreach campaigns end to end. This includes maintaining contact databases, scheduling and coordinating virtual sessions, sending invitations and reminders, tracking attendance, following up with participants, and managing referral pipelines. The expectation is that you can run a campaign independently without the CEO needing to step in at every stage.
* Event and Webinar Logistics Whenever the company hosts webinars, orientations, or live events, you will handle the complete logistics. This covers registration management, attendee communication, calendar coordination, reminders, post event follow ups, and reporting. You will also work with the marketing team to make sure the scheduling and promotion run smoothly.
* Office and Task Management You will act as the office manager for the team. This means setting up and managing project management tools, creating task lists, assigning deadlines, following up on pending items, and preparing weekly completion reports for the CEO. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks and every team member delivers on time. You will also evaluate team performance and flag any bottlenecks.
* PR and Media Relations You will support the company's public relations efforts by drafting press releases, preparing media pitches, and reaching out to relevant financial publications. This also includes coordinating interviews, managing media budgets when allocated, and tracking all coverage and mentions.
* Day to Day Coordination Beyond the structured responsibilities, you will handle miscellaneous coordination across the team and with external parties as needed. This includes follow ups, scheduling, and any coordination that requires someone to connect multiple people or parties. This part of the role is dynamic and driven by the CEO's daily priorities.


**How a Typical Week Looks Like For This Position**
 At the start of the week, you will review the task board, check what is pending from the previous week, and plan your priorities. Monday typically involves a pipeline review where you assess where each partnership and outreach effort stands and decide what needs immediate attention.
   

  

 Through the middle of the week, you will be focused on execution. This means sending outreach emails, following up with people who have not responded, coordinating meetings and presentations for the CEO, working on campaign logistics, and updating project trackers. If there is an upcoming event or webinar, this is when the bulk of the coordination happens.
   

  

 Towards the end of the week, you will shift to tracking and reporting. You will update the CRM, check on the team's task completion status, prepare the weekly report for the CEO, and flag anything that needs attention going into the next week. If there are media or PR tasks, you will use this time to draft pitches or follow up with publications.
   

  

 Throughout the week, there will always be ad hoc tasks and coordination requests from the CEO that require quick turnaround. Flexibility and the ability to switch between tasks smoothly is key.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Must Have Skills**
* Strong communication skills are essential. You should be able to write clear emails, pitch messages, and follow up notes on your own without needing someone to review everything.
* You need to be outgoing and confident. This role involves reaching out to people you have never spoken to before, whether they are potential partners, corporate decision makers, or media contacts. Being hesitant or shy will hold you back.
* Being organised and detail oriented is critical. You will be managing multiple campaigns, pipelines, and task lists at the same time, and nothing should slip.
* You should be a team player with the ability to lead when needed. Part of your job is tracking the team's progress, making sure deadlines are met, and flagging issues before they become problems.
* You must be comfortable with technology and willing to learn new tools quickly. Using AI tools like ChatGPT, Genspark, ClaudeAI to speed up your work (drafting emails, doing research, creating content) is expected, not optional.
* Finally, you need to be proactive and self driven. If something needs to be done, you do it. You should not need to be reminded to follow up or close the loop on tasks.


**Tools You Will Use Daily**
 Zoho Suite (Zoho Projects, Zoho CRM, Zoho Recruit) for project management, client tracking, and recruitment coordination. Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Google Drive) for day to day communication and collaboration. Zoom for scheduling and coordinating virtual meetings and webinars. ChatGPT and other AI tools for drafting emails, research, and content support. Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) especially for pitch decks and proposals. Social media platforms like LinkedIn and X for outreach and PR coordination.
   

  

**Benefits**
**What Does Success Look Like in This Role?**
* You are succeeding in this role when the outreach pipeline is always moving forward. New contacts are being added, follow ups are happening on time, and conversations are progressing towards outcomes.
* Success means that presentations and meetings are being booked regularly and executed well, with all preparation and follow up handled without the CEO needing to get involved in the logistics.
